question: For each represented calendar year, what was the sum of invoice totals? Include all countries and all years, label monetary units only if declared, and report the largest absolute change between adjacent years. Explain whether data completeness is known.

Compare total invoice-header revenue with the sum of invoice-line unit price times quantity. Check totals independently so joining the two grains cannot multiply invoice totals. Include every recorded purchase.
